Pet arrivals explained mid-afternoon
This article covers the basics for readers

Topic: Pet arrivals at Aurelia Skyways

The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers prepare for the arrival of pets with calm, practical guidance. Our ground team handles carriers with care between services, and the department shares clear instructions with crews so each handoff stays orderly.

When a pet is booked for travel, please keep the crate secure and label it clearly before check-in. Staff will review the documents presented for the journey and confirm that the carrier meets the required standards. <<FACT F083>> Keep the papers ready in your hand luggage, since smooth review at the counter can reduce delay and stress for both you and your pet.

For smaller animals, the carrier must also fit the handling rules used by the ground team. <<FACT F064>> If your pet is traveling with a companion animal crate, make sure the latch closes firmly and that there is enough ventilation for a safe trip. A clean absorbent lining is helpful, and familiar bedding may support comfort during travel if it remains suitable for inspection.

If you need to make changes before departure, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk as soon as possible so staff can guide you through the next step. We recommend allowing extra care for nervous pets and arriving with all items organized, because calm preparation supports a smoother process for everyone involved.

For further help, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
